Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Personality Quiz and Customizer Redesign: Redesign the pet customization stage into a split layout with interactive personality traits and preview choices. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off to 67.9% and takes 89s median / 1017s mean, indicating users struggle with pet customization.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Proposition Copy: Update choose_path headline and body text to clearly explain the instant adoption vs AI photo custom pet creation options. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path step is 514s, indicating confusion between choice paths.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting and Pose Hint: Add clear image guidance hints on the photo upload screen highlighting well-lit centered photo examples. (why: Support received reports of custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawning Diagnostic Status Feed: Add real-time desktop render check notifications on the waiting screen so users know their app status. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app stalling, and waiting step has a 2336s mean duration.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Audio and Visibility Ready Alert: Play a gentle chime sound component and highlight banner when pet desktop rendering completes on the waiting screen. (why: Mean time spent on home/waiting screen is 2336s, suggesting users walk away and miss when their pet spawns.)
